Every Partial g(r)

The M3GNet three-body term on and off at inference, for every element pair in every cell. Two campaigns share this page: thirty random-mixture supercells run against our retrain alone, and ten of them re-run so the released model is measured against its own control. Curves are frame-averaged and shown from 1 to 8 Å. The campaigns used different runs and different models — read each within itself, not across.
